# GreekSoup

> The one-person equity research desk, free and open source, for investors and analysts with no coding needed: sixteen screens that read your broker, the filings, the options tape and the public record, running on your own computer. Open source under the MIT licence, your keys stay with you, and it places no orders. Fifteen of the sixteen screens run with no key at all.

Installed with one line on Mac, Windows or Linux. Six brokers connect read-only as it comes and any other is one file written to a contract in the repository. Nothing here needs an account, and no page on this site is behind a login.

## Get started

- [Get started](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/get-started/): What GreekSoup is, what you need, and the three ways to get it running on your own computer.
- [The first ten minutes](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/get-started/first-ten-minutes/): What to open first on a fresh GreekSoup desk with no keys added, and what each screen is already showing you.
- [The sixteen screens](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/get-started/the-screens/): Every screen on the GreekSoup desk in one line each, grouped the way the sidebar groups them, with what each one reads.
- [Notes and the research vault](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/get-started/notes/): GreekSoup keeps your research as plain files in the desk folder, the notes you write and the files you bring in, each one linked to the listings it names, the project it belongs to and the notes it links to.
- [What runs with no key at all](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/get-started/no-key-needed/): Which GreekSoup screens are live with no broker and no data feed, and what each optional key adds.
- [Questions readers ask](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/get-started/faq/): The questions readers ask about GreekSoup before and after installing it, answered plainly.

## Screens

- [The screens, one by one](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/): Every GreekSoup screen on its own page, with a screenshot, what it shows, where each number comes from, and what needs a key.
- [Desk · Home: your broker account, priced live](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/desk-home/): The GreekSoup Desk · Home screen, your broker account read-only in its own market and currency, holdings, cash, open futures and options, margin, plus the US panels every reader gets, the hand-kept US book, the earnings ahead and the insider tape from Form 4 filings.
- [Desk · Book: a portfolio kept by hand, in any market](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/desk-book/): The GreekSoup Desk · Book screen, a portfolio you keep by hand with no broker and no key, any listing Yahoo Finance knows in any market, priced from the free feed and added up per currency.
- [Risk: every book against its index](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/risk/): The GreekSoup Risk screen, beta, volatility, worst drawdown and correlation for every book against an index you choose, what a five percent index day costs, leverage at underlying value, sector concentration, and whether the books hedge each other.
- [Watch · Home: your home market's grid](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/watch-home/): The GreekSoup Watch · Home screen, a watchlist grid in your home market, quoted through your broker with the order book and live ticks in market hours, or through Yahoo's free feed with no broker, plus the home market's results calendar.
- [Watch · US: the US watch grid](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/watch-us/): The GreekSoup Watch · US screen, a grid of US tickers live from Yahoo's free feed in market hours, with the distance from the fifty and two hundred day averages and market cap when a data provider key is set.
- [Global: any symbol from any exchange](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/global/): The GreekSoup Global screen, one grid for any symbol from any exchange, grouped into indices, currencies, commodities, crypto and stocks, quoted from Yahoo's free feed with no key.
- [Funds: track 13F filings for free](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/funds/): The GreekSoup Funds screen, the latest 13F-HR of every fund you follow read straight from SEC EDGAR, with what changed since last quarter, new buys, exits, adds and trims, the share of each company owned, and the 13D and 13G activist feed. No key.
- [Flow: the options tape on any US stock](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/flow/): The GreekSoup Flow screen, what the US options market is positioned for on each of your names, read from CBOE's free delayed chains, put/call on open interest and volume, the put and call walls, the expected move, skew, unusual strikes and day-over-day open-interest builds. No key.
- [Short: FINRA short interest and the daily short-volume ratio](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/short/): The GreekSoup Short screen, FINRA's bi-monthly short interest settlement report and the daily off-exchange short-volume ratio on your US names, kept apart on purpose, with days to cover, the change against the prior settlement, and the trend on each. No key.
- [Capitol: Congress trading disclosures on your names](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/capitol/): The GreekSoup Capitol screen, US Senate and House periodic transaction reports on the names you hold or watch, the raw disclosure feed, and the members you track, read from the House Clerk's public PDFs with no key, both chambers with a data provider key.
- [Calendar: every dated event on every name you hold or watch](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/calendar/): The GreekSoup Calendar screen, results dates, ex-dividend and payment dates, the filings that landed at the SEC on your US names with a link to each, and the home market's results calendar, on two month grids and a day-by-day agenda, reread by the desk on its own. No key.
- [Macro: FRED series in groups, and the economic calendar](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/macro/): The GreekSoup Macro screen, twenty-two FRED series in six groups with two-year sparklines and full history on a click, any series you add, the home market's own cards, and an economic calendar sixty days ahead. No key for the cards.
- [Commodities: fifty-four cards and who each move squeezes](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/commodities/): The GreekSoup Commodities screen, forty-nine commodities and five currency pairs on one board, each with its level, five change windows and the distance from its five-year high, the industries a rise squeezes and helps, the listed names mapped to each from their own filings, and a names-under-pressure panel. No key.
- [Chain: your own value-chain maps, priced live](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/chain/): The GreekSoup Chain screen, your own value-chain maps for any industry or product, drafted by your AI from a line of description, upstream to downstream, every line yours to keep, change or drop, the listed names at each step priced live, and kept as plain files in your research vault.
- [Notes: the research vault as one screen](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/notes/): The GreekSoup Notes screen, your research vault, every note and every file you bring in as plain files in a folder you choose, indexed by name, project and subject, with tasks, a journal the desk fills, a name's timeline, live blocks carrying the desk's numbers inside a note, and search inside the files.
- [Any ticker: one page a name, chart to filings](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/ticker/): The GreekSoup ticker page, one page for any listed name, the desk's own chart with indicators and drawings, valuation, quality, earnings, the analyst street view, the fifty-two week range, insider filings from EDGAR, dividends, your notes and tasks on the name, and with a data provider key six years of statements, estimates, peers and a DCF sandbox.
- [Settings: three tabs, nothing required](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/screens/settings/): The GreekSoup Settings screen, three tabs, Connect for a broker per market, the data provider and your AI, Your desk for screens, the vault, how you invest, the journal and backups, and Plugins. Every key is optional and stays in a file on your own computer.

## Install

- [Install](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/): The ways to install GreekSoup on a Mac, Windows or Linux computer: one line in a terminal, with an AI agent, or from source.
- [Install on a Mac](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/mac/): Install GreekSoup on a Mac with one line in Terminal.
- [Install on Windows](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/windows/): Install GreekSoup on Windows with one line in PowerShell.
- [Install on Linux](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/linux/): Install GreekSoup on Linux with one line, kept running by a systemd user service.
- [Install with an AI agent](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/with-an-agent/): Have an AI coding agent install GreekSoup, connect your broker and fill in your keys for you.
- [Install from source](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/from-source/): Set GreekSoup up by hand from a clone of the repository.
- [Keep it running](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/keep-it-running/): How GreekSoup starts with your computer and comes back by itself if it stops, and the files that switch that on and off.
- [Getting a newer version](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/updates/): How GreekSoup tells you a newer version exists and brings it in with one click, keeping your keys and your lists.
- [Back up](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/back-up/): One zip of everything on the GreekSoup desk that is yours.
- [Uninstall](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/uninstall/): Remove GreekSoup from your computer completely: one file to double-click, or one line, and nothing is left behind.
- [What it talks to](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/what-it-talks-to/): Every place GreekSoup sends a request, what it sends, and what it never sends. No telemetry, no account, no analytics.
- [Your computer or a server](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/your-computer-or-a-server/): Whether to run GreekSoup on the computer in front of you or on a rented server, and why the desk's safety story holds on a laptop and turns around on a VPS.
- [If something is wrong](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/if-something-is-wrong/): Symptom first. What each thing a GreekSoup screen can do means, and the one check that tells your agent what to fix.
- [Known issues](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/known-issues/): Every problem a GreekSoup reader has reported, dated, with what it means and the version that fixed it. Newest first.
- [The page is blank](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/install/the-page-is-blank/): What to do when the GreekSoup address does not open, in order.

## Setup

- [Setup](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/setup/): The Settings screen inside GreekSoup: your broker, your data provider, your AI, how you invest, the always-on switch, your files and a backup, all in one place.
- [Your AI](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/setup/your-ai/): Three ways to have an AI on the GreekSoup desk: an app you already pay for (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Kimi Code, Grok Build, Qwen Code, Cursor) without a key, your own key from any of fourteen labs, or a model running on your own computer. What the Ask box sends, and what the desk never sees.
- [Your lists](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/setup/your-lists/): Every list a GreekSoup screen runs on is yours: the funds you follow, the members you track, the macro series, the commodities on the board, the names on the options tape, and the index Risk measures against. The Your list drawer, starters, undo, and where your rows live.
- [Chains](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/setup/chains/): Building your own value-chain map on the GreekSoup Chain screen: layers upstream to downstream, the listed names under each with a receipt, the named supplier-to-customer links, and the AI draft that fills the first version from your description.
- [Plugins](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/setup/plugins/): A GreekSoup plugin is a folder that adds a screen to the sidebar, blocks a note can carry, or a door for the Ask box, such as the terminal door that answers through the coding agent already on your computer.
- [Two computers](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/setup/two-computers/): How the GreekSoup research vault reaches a second computer, or a colleague, with no service and no account, through a folder you already sync.
- [Data providers](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/setup/data-providers/): What a data provider key adds to GreekSoup, the one that ships (Financial Modeling Prep), and how any other provider is one file to a written contract.
- [Data sources](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/setup/data-sources/): Every source behind GreekSoup's sixteen screens, what each one feeds, and which need a key.

## Brokers

- [Brokers](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/brokers/): How GreekSoup connects to a broker account, read-only, and which six connect as the desk comes.
- [Alpaca](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/brokers/alpaca/): Connect an Alpaca account to GreekSoup: where the keys come from, the paper switch, and what the desk shows.
- [ICICI Direct](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/brokers/icici-direct/): Connect an ICICI Direct account to GreekSoup through the Breeze API: the app, the daily login, and the full Home screen it serves.
- [Interactive Brokers](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/brokers/interactive-brokers/): Connect an Interactive Brokers account to GreekSoup through the Flex Web Service, with no gateway program to run.
- [Tradier](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/brokers/tradier/): Connect a Tradier account to GreekSoup with one access token.
- [Trading 212](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/brokers/trading-212/): Connect a Trading 212 Invest or ISA account to GreekSoup with a key generated in the app.
- [Zerodha](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/brokers/zerodha/): Connect a Zerodha account to GreekSoup through Kite Connect, with a login every trading day.
- [Another broker](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/brokers/another-broker/): Connect a broker GreekSoup does not ship a file for, with an AI agent and the broker's own documentation.

## Markets

- [Markets](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/markets/): How the home screens of GreekSoup take the shape of the market your broker trades in, and what a market file supplies.
- [India](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/markets/india/): What the India market file gives the GreekSoup home screens: NSE hours, NIFTY 50, the results calendar, the integrated filings and three macro cards.
- [United States](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/markets/united-states/): What the United States market file gives the GreekSoup home screens when a US broker is connected.
- [Your own market](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/markets/your-own-market/): Add a market GreekSoup does not ship, with one short file written by an AI agent to the markets contract.

## Compare

- [GreekSoup beside the tools you already know](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/compare/): Where GreekSoup sits beside Bloomberg, Koyfin, TradingView, Perplexity and the open-source field, said plainly, with what it does not do.
- [Free Bloomberg terminal alternatives for individual investors](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/compare/bloomberg-alternatives/): The free tools an individual investor can use instead of a Bloomberg terminal in 2026, what each covers, what none of them cover, and where GreekSoup, the free and open-source research desk, fits.
- [GreekSoup vs Perplexity for stock research](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/compare/vs-perplexity/): How GreekSoup, the free open-source research desk, differs from Perplexity Finance for researching a stock with AI. One searches the web and writes an answer; the other puts the record on a screen and lets the AI you already use read it.
- [Open-source equity research software: what exists](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/compare/open-source-equity-research-software/): The open-source equity research software an individual can actually run in September 2026: OpenBB after its wind-down, Ghostfolio, Portfolio Performance, the backtesting engines, and GreekSoup, the free one-person research desk. Licence, install effort and what each covers.
- [How to research a stock with AI without the numbers being made up](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/compare/research-a-stock-with-ai/): A five-step method for researching a stock with an AI so that every number in the answer comes from the record rather than the model's memory, and how the GreekSoup desk is built around it.
- [Is GreekSoup for developers?](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/compare/for-developers/): No. GreekSoup is a free, open-source equity research desk for investors and analysts who do not write code. One pasted line installs it, the settings are a screen, and an AI agent makes any change. What a developer gets is listed too.

- [Contributing](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/project/contributing/): How to add a broker, a market or a data provider to GreekSoup, and what every contribution keeps true.
- [Security](https://greeksoup.ai/docs/project/security/): The GreekSoup threat model in plain words, what the desk does about each threat, the honest limits, whether to run it on your own computer or a server, and how to report a problem privately.
